desc:
🌴 WELCOME TO RIO DE JANEIRO ROLEPLAY!

🌆 Explore the Wonderful City in one of the most realistic Brazilian RP games on Roblox! Discover beaches, communities, luxury neighborhoods, and various places inspired by Rio de Janeiro!

🏡 CREATE YOUR STORY!

Buy houses, cars, and choose your profession! Be a police officer, doctor, delivery person, truck driver, pizza maker, or live as a citizen.

💰 BIG ROBBERIES!

Participate in bank, port, jewelry store, and museum robberies! Gather your team and face exciting police chases!

🎮 Commands and Keys

🎒 /check [player] | Search
🤝 /trade [player] | Trade
📱 M | Mobile Phone
🔒 J | Lock vehicle
🔫 F | Store weapon
🎒 Y | Backpack
🅿️ V | Rollers
🚨 H, P, J, K | Spinners and sirens
💪 P | Carry body
🏃 Shift | Run
📸 Ctrl | Lock camera

🌟 Rio de Janeiro Roleplay: Your City, Your Story!
